children: SHANGHAI and CAMBRIDGE, Mass, Nov. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Zai Lab Limited (

), an innovation-driven, global biopharma company, today announced that five of its commercial medicines in China have been included in the country's 2026 National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL). The update includes two first-time listings, expanding patient access to treatments for gMG and schizophrenia, and three renewals, which maintain access across oncology and infectious disease.
Zai Lab Products Newly Added or Renewed in 2026 NRDL:
First-time listings:
VYVGART Hytrulo® (efgartigimod alfa, subcutaneous injection): for the treatment of adult patients with anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG).
KarXT (xanomeline and trospium chloride capsules): for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults.
Renewals:
NUZYRA® (omadacycline for injection): for the treatment of community-acquired bacterial pneumonia and acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections.

QINLOCK® (ripretinib tablets): for the treatment of adult patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) who have received prior treatment with three or more kinase inhibitors, including imatinib.

AUGTYRO® (repotrectinib capsules): for the treatment of adult patients with ROS1-positive locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and adult patients with solid tumors harboring a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion.

"The inclusion of KarXT and VYVGART Hytrulo in the NRDL represents an important milestone for Zai Lab and the patients we serve," said Dr. Yizhe Wang, Zai Lab Operating Partner. "These listings will help broaden access to two important therapies, including KarXT's novel mechanism of action for schizophrenia and the convenience of VYVGART Hytrulo's subcutaneous administration for patients with gMG. Together with the renewal of our other listed products, we are grateful to the National Healthcare Security Administration for its continued support of innovative medicines and remain committed to delivering greater benefit to patients."
The 2026 National Reimbursement Drug List will take effect on January 1, 2027.
Notice:

*xanomeline and trospium chloride capsules included in the 2026 NRDL covers the following specifications: (I) xanomeline tartrate 50 mg (calculated as C14H23N3OS) and trospium chloride 20 mg per capsule; (II) xanomeline tartrate 100 mg (as C14H23N3OS) and trospium chloride 20 mg per capsule; (III) xanomeline tartrate 125 mg (as C14H23N3OS) and trospium chloride 30 mg per capsule. All are indicated for schizophrenia in adults.
*For AUGTYRO

included in the 2026 NRDL, the reimbursement scope for adult patients with NTRK gene fusion-positive solid tumors is specifically: adult patients diagnosed, by a well-validated testing method, with solid tumors harboring a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, and who meet one of the following conditions: having locally advanced or metastatic disease, or for whom surgical resection is likely to result in severe complications, or who have failed prior treatment or have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.
